blurCommitFix.rootCause: The blur candidate policy unconditionally rejected changed DOM without final evidence, including a completed provisional input matching the strictly reconciled replacement. Restoration could then emit an empty compositionend and recursively spend the same lease.
blurCommitFix.fix: On blur, allow changed replacement only when latest provisional source is input and text matches reconciled DOM; retain final-conflict, DOM, range and Unicode checks. Ignore owned empty compositionend only during synchronous restoration.
blurCommitFix.redBeforeFix: Three focused state/controller/router regressions failed because candidate was unavailable, controller requested recovery, and no command was submitted.
